marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Eva is a simple girl. The only exciting about her is that she has a string of fraudulent insurance claims amounting to RM 100 million tied to her name. Yet in the past five year, no insurance investigator has ever found any evidence of her fraud activities. Until, Nik happens to be the one of top insurance fraud investigators in Europe. Hence, it is his responsibility to catch Eva red handed. The only problem is they began developing a liking between each other. And now Nik has a choice. Simply put...love or honor.
